token_family_docs.$description: Brand mode collection (proof of concept). Modes: CH_app (the base — no class is applied), CH_marketing (.ob-brand-ch-marketing), ZH (.ob-brand-zh), FR (.ob-brand-fr). Each mode carries the CSS class string the application adds to a container to activate it. The mode picks the brand ramp for emphasis_high interaction and the brand accent.

selector.$description: CH_app is the base brand mode — no class is applied. It is the first-paint default.
CH_marketing is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
ZH is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
FR is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
